title: Cost-based optimizer and join ordering
scope: optimizer statistics, EXPLAIN, index access, and comma join ordering

summary: EXPLAIN reports estimated rows and cost for table access when ANALYZE stats exist.
EXPLAIN reports implicit comma join order and join estimate for 3+ table joins.
Index scan planning uses ANALYZE estimates to expand candidate probe caps when the index remains cheaper than a full scan.
Comma join reorder uses ANALYZE row_count before falling back to live count_prefix.
